0.original: Hirase is pondering what to make the Confederates for <hex:02083BE3E90C0DFF1C020818E3E90C05FF0764696E6E6572FF0A627265616B6661737403FF18020814E3E90C12FF066C756E6368FF0764696E6E65720303>.

24.original: Obtain slabs of hearty gyuki meat from gyuki.

25.original: Deliver the slabs of hearty gyuki meat to Hirase.

48.original: Bah! You scared me! I was just contemplating what to make the hungry men and women of Onokoro for <hex:02083BE3E90C0DFF1C020818E3E90C05FF0764696E6E6572FF0A627265616B6661737403FF18020814E3E90C12FF066C756E6368FF0764696E6E65720303>. As the resident chef, it is my responsibility to see that they are provided with good, nutritious meals.

49.original: I think today we will be having a pirate's stew. Makes your mouth water, doesn't it?

50.original: Problem is, I am missing a key ingredient. <sigh> Our revenue from the Ruby Tithe has been slowly declining and the treasurer has cut down on my budget. I am now unable to afford the juicy meat that makes this stew a proper pirate's stew.

51.original: Regardless, it is my job to find a way to keep our pirates healthy and full. That means I must find an alternative way to procure my meats. Perhaps you could assist me?

52.original: To the west of here are wild gyuki. Might you kill a few and bring me back slabs of this meat? In the meantime, I will go and search the sea for other foods to put into the stew.

53.original: Please bring back a few slabs of meat from the wild gyuki wandering to the west of here.

54.original: You have brought me back my meat? Fantastic! Simply fantastic! With this, my stew is now complete!

55.original: Do you smell that, my good <hex:02080EE905FF056C616479FF046D616E03>? Now, that is the smell of a proper meal!

56.original: Once we slide the hot stones into the pot, and the seawater begins to boil the seafood and meat, the already heavenly aroma will become all the sweeter!

57.original: We have the Ruby Sea to thank for such a luxurious bounty. By her we are blessed and in partaking of her food we shall be protected─unless you are foolish enough to swallow one of the hot stones, that is! Hahaha!

58.original: Thank you for your help, my friend. I hope this shall suffice as payment for your services.
